subject: FluxData marketplace onboarding — legal entity & PO provisioning
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@fluxdata.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T14:12:00+02:00
Subject: FluxData seller registration + PO routing for AWS/Azure marketplace

Hi Laura / Vanessa,

Thanks for the intro — we’re excited to get FluxData listed in the AWS and Azure marketplaces and to kick off a private-offer flow with Redwood. Two quick things that came up on our side during preflight:

- Legal entity mismatch: our legal entity for EU operations is FluxData GmbH (VAT DE123456789) but our bank/invoice entity is FluxData Holdings Ltd. The seller registration form asks for the entity that will appear on invoices — can you confirm the best way to handle POs/invoices so they match?
- Marketplace PO mapping: our procurement team needs a clear PO-to-invoice routing so their finance system can automatically map invoice payee. Can Redwood provide the exact payee alias you need on the invoice and the email to send PDFs to?

I’ve attached the seller registration form and our preliminary banking file. We can also provide the VAT certificate and registration extracts if that helps.

Proposed timeline: complete seller registration this week, accept private offer, then test a single invoice flow before go-live.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call today if useful.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Partnerships, FluxData
attachments: FluxData_SellerRegistration_Form.xlsx, FluxData_Bank_Details.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@fluxdata.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T15:35:00+02:00
Subject: Re: FluxData seller registration + PO routing for AWS/Azure marketplace

Hi Emma — welcome, and great detail — this is exactly the kind of nuance we want up front. Short answers and next steps below.

1) Payee alias / invoice routing
- For Marketplace listings (AWS, Azure) we require invoices to reference the seller legal entity that matches the Marketplace Seller Registration. If FluxData will invoice as FluxData GmbH, that should be the entity on the private offer and invoice.
- For routing to our AR team please have invoices sent as PDF to: eu-billing@redwood-inference.com and cc: finance-ops@fluxdata.com (per your internal controls).

2) Legal mismatch options
- Option A (preferred): update the Marketplace Seller Registration to FluxData GmbH so invoices, PO payee, and seller entry match.
- Option B: if FluxData must invoice from Holdings Ltd, we can accept that but require a signed intercompany invoice addendum (we can provide the template) and proof of remittance rights. This adds a procurement/legal step.

3) Required documents we’ll need to clear the PO lane:
- Signed seller registration (sheet you've attached)
- VAT certificate (EU) — PDF (attach)
- Bank details (IBAN, SWIFT) — CSV or PDF
- Official registration extract (company registry)

4) Marketplace private offer flow
- We will create a private offer in AWS with FluxData’s seller ID. Tom Johnson (AWS) is copied on this thread to coordinate any seller-side mapping.

Next steps: Can you confirm whether you can update the seller registration to FluxData GmbH? If not, confirm that Holdings Ltd will be invoicing and I’ll kick off the addendum.

I’ll also loop in our procurement lead to build the PO routing mapping once we have the VAT cert.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_PO_Routing_Guide.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T09:08:00+02:00
Subject: Internal: FluxData PO lane & validation tasks

Laura / Kimberly — quick internal note on next actions from procurement: 

- I will open the vendor intake ticket and create a billing alias called fluxdata_gmbh_eu. That alias will be the payee string that our AR system expects on invoices: "FluxData GmbH / VAT DE123456789".
- Compliance: need Kimberly to confirm there are no sanctions or PEP flags.
- Tax: we will validate the VAT certificate against VIES; if it fails we will ask for additional proof.

Proposed timeline: vendor intake + mapping today, validate VAT by EOD tomorrow, then confirm whether we can accept invoices from Holdings Ltd under addendum (if FluxData cannot update seller registration).

Kimberly — can you take compliance hold? I’ll draft the PO routing mapping and a short intercompany addendum if needed.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma@fluxdata.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fluxdata.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T08:27:00+02:00
Subject: Re: FluxData seller registration + PO routing for AWS/Azure marketplace

Thanks Laura — we can update the Marketplace Seller Registration to FluxData GmbH (DE123456789). I’ve attached the VAT certificate and updated bank file.

We prefer Option A (match seller registration) — that will be faster for our procurement team. Bank transfers will be in EUR to the Germany entity. 

Attachments: FluxData_VAT_certificate.pdf, FluxData_Bank_Details.csv

If you need an extract from the Handelsregister we can provide that too — we’ll send it by EOD if helpful. Happy to review the private offer before it’s issued.

Regards,
Emma
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@fluxdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tom Johnson <tom.johnson@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T11:03:00+02:00
Subject: Re: FluxData seller registration + PO routing for AWS/Azure marketplace

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Emma. Summary and immediate next steps from Redwood: 

- We will proceed with Option A (register seller as FluxData GmbH). Procurement will create the billing alias fluxdata_gmbh_eu and map PO routing to eu-billing@redwood-inference.com.
- Ben will validate the VAT cert in VIES and confirm clearance (Ben: pls reply here if any issues).
- Tom/AWS: once seller ID is updated, please confirm the private offer can reference FluxData GmbH and that ledger mapping will pass through to Redwood’s AR.
- I will create the HubSpot deal and attach the seller docs (link included): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HD-9847

Checklist for FluxData to close this sprint:
1) Finalized seller registration (done)
2) VAT certificate (attached)
3) Bank details (attached)
4) Confirm private offer draft (we will send)

I’ll follow up once Ben confirms VAT validation and once AWS confirms private-offer mapping. Thanks everyone — looks like we can keep to the planned go-live next week.

Best,
Laura
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
